claims: The 2026 tax season corresponds to the 2025 tax year.
Submitting Form 4868 by April 15, 2026 provides an automatic free extension to file a federal tax return until October 15, 2026.
A tax extension provides extra time to file but not to pay.
Taxes owed are due by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
The new return deadline with extension is October 15, 2026.
IRS Free File can be used to submit Form 4868.
Tax software can be used to submit Form 4868.
Direct Pay can be used for an extension by selecting 'Extension' as the reason.
Residents in specific Mississippi disaster areas have an automatic extension until June 8 without filing Form 4868.
Residents in Tennessee disaster areas have an automatic extension without filing Form 4868.
The failure to file penalty is significantly higher than the failure-to-pay penalty.
Filing an extension avoids the failure to file penalty.
The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau provides a Guide to filing your taxes in 2026.
TurboTax offers a dedicated page to help file an extension.
